title: Gex
overview:
Gex must escape the media dimension by using his thrashing tail and suction cup paws! Over 450 frames of 3D animation and hand-rendered backgrounds!

Gex, a TV-obsessed gecko, has been pulled through his own television by Rez, ruler of the Media Dimension, who wants to make him a network mascot. Fight your way through five TV-themed worlds - from haunted graveyards to cartoon land and kung fu country - to find the hidden remote controls that unlock new levels, and defeat each world's boss to reach the next.

Gex sticks to walls and ceilings, whips enemies with his tail, bounces off foes with a coiled tail spring and snaps up bug power-ups with his tongue for fire breath, extra speed and more. Hunt down hidden video tapes for passwords and bonus rooms that lead to the secret Planet X.
